ani: Canary v4.0.0 -> eu-west-1 is live (2%). Starting lightweight post-deploy smoke: tokenization, embed sanity, and a short user-flow replay. Will watch 20m.

deploy-bot: canary applied: eu-west-1 @2%. readiness ok. synth-runner kicking off `short-suite + embed-sanity`.

marc: Short-suite started: `./tools/smoke --suite=short --region=eu-west-1 --checks=tok,embed,flow` 

ops-bot: interim synth: token checks 16/16 ok, embed sanity 12/13 (one low-similarity alert), p50=44ms p95=130ms. Posting link to probe heatmap: https://console.redwood/synth/3891234000/heatmap

sanjay: Sample embed alert: query_id=e7f2 low-similarity=0.12 expected>=0.25. It came from model-variant v4.0.0-quant which differs from v3.9.8 baseline. Logs:```
11:08:10 embed-eu req=e7f1 var=v3.9.8 sim=0.33
11:08:11 embed-eu req=e7f2 var=v4.0.0-quant sim=0.12
11:08:12 embed-eu req=e7f3 var=v4.0.0-quant sim=0.30
```

ani: Interesting — a single outlier could be quantization edge-case. Proposal: pause staged ramp. Pin embed routes in eu-west-1 to v3.9.8; keep canary v4.0.0 at 2% for 30m while we run targeted embed-regression probes. If low-similarity rate <=0.3% and no semantic drift -> continue. If >1% for 5m -> rollback to v3.9.8. Add release note: "Investigating embed sim variance on v4.0.0-quant; pinning embed routes."

deploy-bot: rollout paused by ani. pin set: eu-west-1 embed-routes -> v3.9.8 at 2% until 3891235800.

marc: I'll launch `./tools/embed-check --variant=v4.0.0-quant --bench=canary-samples --repeat=200` now, posting summary in ~8m.

qa-bot: queued targeted probe: 200 comparisons across short-tail and long-tail prompts. Expected baseline sim median 0.31. Will flag any buckets with median drop >0.08.

sanjay: Also seeing a tiny tail latency bump on quant hosts: p99 increased from 520ms -> 780ms for a few samples, correlates with CPU frequency scaling on older gpus. Running gputop snapshot and node-telemetry link: https://telemetry.redwood/gpu/3891234000

ani: Owners: marc (embed regression probe), sanjay (gpu telemetry), ops-bot (alerts/dash). Decision: hold global ramp. If embed probes finish and median sim recovers to within 0.05 of baseline and p99 latency returns below 600ms -> unpause and proceed to 20% tomorrow change window. If not, we'll cut v4.0.1 (remove the quant fallback) or rollback. Reconvene in 12m or on any threshold. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
